aa173055cabb.quote: ARTICLE 17. General Bylaw Amendment Chapter 55 — Dogs To see if the Town will vote to amend Chapter 55 of the Town’s General Bylaws, “Dogs”, by inserting new sections 55-5A, 55-5B and 55-5C and amending sections 55-1 and 55-10, all as set forth in the similarly titled documents on file with the Town Clerk; or take any other action relative thereto. (By: Select Board)
